links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of LLM responses to breast imaging questions
links.effect: Gemini and Microsoft Copilot scored higher on readability scales (p < 0.001) than ChatGPT-4; ChatGPT-4 readability issues may limit its utility in patient education.
links.quote: While LLMs such as ChatGPT-4 show promise in providing accurate responses, readability issues may limit their utility in patient education.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three off-the-shelf LLMs answering frequently asked breast imaging questions, assessing readability formulas and expert-rated accuracy without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
